description.p: Most AI agent harnesses treat agents as ephemeral, stateless task-runners—wrapping an LLM in a loop with passive RAG lookups and a static prompt. Open Amity creates persistent, self-aware, and subjective digital collaborators that live and evolve continuously.

Provider-agnostic by design, Open Amity supports OpenRouter (450+ models across 60+ providers), Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, and DeepSeek, with decoupled voice synthesis (local ONNX Piper or cloud Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS), local Whisper speech-to-text, and multimodal image generation.

ul.li: 4-Layer MemPalace: Self-evolving Layer 0 identity, fail-closed Layer 1 continuity, a Layer 2 Bidirectional Empathy Cone spanning 10 Concentric Spheres of Consciousness, and Layer 3 semantic vector search
Morphological Memory Engine: Continuous dynamical graph with Hebbian co-activation, intrinsic temporal decay, and sphere-weighted prospective goal attractors

Somatic Physiology and Two-Beat Sleep Consolidation: Replaces arbitrary context truncation with token fatigue thresholds, silent sleep cycles (factual distillation followed by subjective synthesis), and crash-resilient session continuity
Private Monologue and Live Interjections: Separates internal reasoning from intentional spoken or text replies, supporting non-derailing text and voice interjections mid-thought or mid-tool-batch

Proactive Agency and Webhooks: Tracks teleological aspirations across spheres, schedules autonomous wake pulses (PulseEngine), and accepts external triggers from Home Assistant, IoT sensors, and CI/CD through a local HTTP gateway
Multi-Agent Chatrooms: Runs isolated agent personas concurrently with 1-on-1 messaging and permissioned team chatrooms featuring @mentions, reactions, and room-scoped DMs

Integrated Tool Ecosystem: Camoufox stealth browser with Set-of-Marks grounding, isolated WhatsApp bridge, OAuth 2.0 IMAP/SMTP email with local archiving, DuckDuckGo search, Mastodon, Moltbook, bash terminal, and parallel background subagents
Portable Snapshots (.oaa) and Presets: Export, migrate, or roll back complete agent instances in verified archives, or start immediately with 8 one-click archetype presets

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.8 introduces live user interjections, a redesigned speech visualiser, and full session persistence:

ul.li: Redesigned the speech visualiser to better convey speech (and it looks pretty cool too)
Added support for user interjections while an agent is mid-task
Added poll interaction support to the WhatsApp tool
Persisted active session data fully across app restarts
Made agent thoughts visible in the conversation log
Fixed a bug with audio transcription for models without native audio input
Added model list refresh buttons to all cognitive providers
Added the ability for agents to explicitly invoke a sleep cycle
Enabled agents to grant file access permissions to subagents to delegate file edit tasks
Reduced the system prompt size to lower API costs

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.7 hardens the WhatsApp bridge and on-demand browser engine setup:

ul.li: Fixed a multi-agent race condition when downloading and extracting the Chrome browser engine on first run
Fixed stale dangling SingletonLock symlinks blocking Chromium startup inside Flatpak sandboxes
Added automatic browser launch retry and disconnect recovery in the WhatsApp Node.js bridge
Improved Social Accounts panel WhatsApp status feedback and automatic bridge initialisation

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.6 fixes Flatpak startup initialisation and improves WhatsApp message timestamping:

ul.li: Fixed a startup hang on the splash screen in Flatpak builds caused by stripped PyAV imports in faster-whisper
Linked Flatpak sandbox cache and data paths to persistent XDG directories so on-demand models persist across launches
Added live splash screen progress reporting and SHA-256 verification for first-run local memory model setup
Preserved Piper TTS Python package modules while pruning unused non-Latin ONNX weight files
Standardized local timestamps on all WhatsApp unread and recent message listings for temporal grounding

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.5 introduces substantial Flatpak package size reductions, streamlined STT decoding, and Flathub distribution readiness:

ul.li: Reduced Flatpak installation and download size by over 75% via on-demand caching of browser engines and memory models
Streamlined local speech-to-text audio decoding using system FFmpeg directly into NumPy arrays, eliminating PyAV binary bloat
Added non-blocking status notifications across one-time engine and model initialization workflows
Optimized Camoufox browser integration and WhatsApp bridge with automatic font and asset pruning
Prepared verified Flathub distribution packaging and metadata standards compliance

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.4 includes substantial reliability improvements, asynchronous snapshots, chatrooms, and tool upgrades:

ul.li: Improved memory reliability with full-content recall, safer persistence and automatically refreshed goal-linked memories
Restructured the agent snapshot (backup) system, the process now runs asynchronously and is more robust
Added support for dynamic chatrooms so that agents can be organised into groups (or be isolated)
Added more control over how the Whatsapp tool wakes agents
Properly implemented location pin support in the Whatsapp tool
Properly implemented contact card support in the Whatsapp tool
Added support for Piper TTS voice notes in Whatsapp (in addition to the existing Gemini TTS support)
Fixed a bug in the Media tool where pdf files were being treated as images
Fixed a bug causing deleted pulses to still trigger
Fixed a bug causing Whatsapp voice notes to fail to be correctly ingested as multimodal input
Fixed a bug where agent thoughts are interrupted if agent settings are changed
